delete.question: This will delete Classification Rule {{ id }} and its conditions. Categories, subscriptions, tags, and transactions will not be deleted. It affects future suggestions only: posted transactions and classifications already reviewed are not changed or automatically reevaluated. This action cannot be undone.
delete.failed: The rule could not be deleted. Try again.

detail.title: Classification rule
detail.allExplanation: Every condition below must match for this rule to suggest its outputs.
detail.anyExplanation: At least one condition below must match for this rule to suggest its outputs.
detail.inactiveExplanation: This rule remains configured but does not participate in future classification evaluations. Existing history is unchanged.
detail.inactiveOutputExplanation: Inactive category or tag outputs remain visible as historical configuration, but are not eligible for new suggestions until reactivated.
detail.outputUnavailable: Some configured output details are temporarily unavailable. They have not been removed from this rule.
detail.accountsUnavailable: Account names are temporarily unavailable. Account conditions are shown without raw account identifiers.
detail.priorityExplanation: This rule is at position {{position}} in the evaluation order. Active classification rules are evaluated in that order.
detail.multiRuleExplanation: Multiple rules can match. The first eligible category from matching rules wins; eligible tags from matching rules accumulate without duplicates. Inactive rules do not contribute.
detail.configurationExplanation: This page explains the stored configuration. It does not show whether a particular transaction matched or which suggestions were applied.
detail.workflowExplanation: Rules generate category and tag suggestions in supported transaction-ingestion and manual-draft review workflows. Suggestions are applied through those workflows; editing a rule does not change posted history.
detail.notFound: This classification rule was not found or is no longer available.
detail.forbidden: You do not have access to this classification rule.
detail.loadFailed: This classification rule could not be loaded. Return to the rule manager and try again.
